'''''Resolve''''' was an [[Epoch-class freighter|''Epoch''-class freighter]] manufactured by [[Shobquix Yards]]. The ''Resolve'' was owned and operated by the [[Svivreni]] [[Mihalik]]. The vessel was a gift to Mihalik from [[Caleb Hctaqsas]] for an undefined favor. The ''Resolve'' was fitted with thrust packages from [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]] and [[KapriCorp/Legends|KapriCorp]], giving it a better lift to mass ratio.
